        An observatory of pairings and their evidence.

        Local prototype · 28.10.2026
        READING THE DATA

        Compare what is comparable.

        Pairwise brings published results together. This preview runs no new benchmarks and names no universal winner.

        01

        Context before ranking

        Tables stay separate by source and protocol. A score of 75% on two different suites does not mean the same thing.

        02

        Unknowns stay visible

        A dash means “not reported”. It never becomes zero cost, a recent version, or assumed compatibility.

        03

        More than one way to succeed

        Mean scores may include partial credit. Full credit measures completely validated deliverables. Costs and durations retain their original scope.

        04

        Evidence you can inspect

        Every record links to its publication. Observations are imported, not independently reproduced. Check the original source for harness versions and detailed conditions missing from the export.

        Frozen data for this local preview. No automated monitoring is enabled.
